# Gianni Perugini

> Official portfolio and digital art store of Gianni Perugini, a creative director and digital media specialist working across digital art, photography, video and motion, and interface design.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://gianniperugini.com/): One-screen cinematic entrance to Gianni Perugini's work.
- [Digital Art Store](https://gianniperugini.com/archive.html): Watermarked previews, current USD pricing, personal-use collections, complete archives, and Payhip purchase links.
- [Portfolio](https://gianniperugini.com/projects.html): Wet Neon Noir, How I work with AI, IceDraft Pool, Ground Control Dashboard, Glace Noire Media, and Rent360 Landing Concept.
- [Wet Neon Noir](https://gianniperugini.com/wet-neon-noir.html): Still-to-motion cut from the Wet Neon Noir series. Sequence Alley Pulse → Alley Car → Glass Rain. 12.75s, 1920×1080, 24fps.
- [How I work with AI](https://gianniperugini.com/how-i-work-with-ai.html): Models in use, where AI enters, what stays hand-finished, and the generation-log format kept for reproducibility.
- [IceDraft case study](https://gianniperugini.com/icedraft.html): Problem, role, process, UI system, stack, screenshots, then the live app.
- [Ground Control Dashboard case study](https://gianniperugini.com/ember-cathedral-case-study.html): Private business command center — fail-closed metrics, Markdown as source of truth, read-only OAuth integrations. Runs locally by design; no public app URL.
- [Rent360 case study](https://gianniperugini.com/rent360-case-study.html): Unofficial SaaS landing-page concept — objection-led conversion flow, product mocks built as live HTML components, and a disclosure system that labels every invented figure.
- [Rent360 live concept](https://gianniperugini.com/rent360/): The concept page itself. Rent360 is not a real company; all metrics, listings, guests and reviews are invented sample data, and the gallery photography is public domain (CC0).
- [Photography](https://gianniperugini.com/photography.html): Selected field and studio photographs. Portfolio gallery only — not the Digital Art Store.
- [About](https://gianniperugini.com/about.html): Professional biography, LinkedIn, and résumé PDF.
- [Contact](https://gianniperugini.com/contact.html): Direct email, inquiry form, LinkedIn, and résumé PDF.
- [Standard Commercial Licence](https://gianniperugini.com/commercial-licence.html): Authoritative commercial licence permissions and restrictions.

## Digital art products

- Individual wallpaper: one artwork in 4K desktop and mobile formats for personal use; $1 USD minimum pay-what-you-want via Payhip from the Digital Art Store lightbox.
- Collection: 12 mobile wallpapers from $4 USD, 12 4K desktop wallpapers from $4 USD, or all 24 files from $6 USD.
- Complete personal archive: 14 collections; mobile or desktop from $19 USD, or both formats from $29 USD.
- Complete commercial archive: 14 collections and 336 files from $79 USD under the Standard Commercial Licence.
- Prices marked with a plus sign are minimum pay-what-you-want prices. Buyers may enter a higher amount to support the artist.

## Important facts

- Products are digital downloads; no physical item is shipped.
- Desktop wallpapers are 3840 × 2160 JPG files.
- Mobile wallpapers are 1440 × 2560 JPG files and may use compositions different from the desktop versions.
- The website shows watermarked sales previews. Purchased download files are governed by the licence included with the applicable product.
- Payhip handles checkout and digital delivery.

For product availability, pricing, and licence terms, use the official pages linked above as the authoritative source.
